contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FL IVL HELENAE AVG ; R/ PAX PVBLICA

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Helena (consort of Emperor Constantius, and the mother of Emperor Constantine I) dating from 9th April 337 to April 340 AD. Minted in Trier. Obverse Legend: FL IVL HELENAE AVG (Empress facing right). Reverse Legend: PAX PVBLICA (Pax facing left holding a branch left). Mint mark: .TRP. RIC volume VIII, Trier, Number 47. Reece period 17
